==About==

A Lavender Blewit can be found in the wild or, with the [[Fungiculture]] skill learned, grown by planting another {{i|Lavender Blewit}} in a {{i|Gardening Pot}}. When planting a Lavender Blewit there is a chance for it to grow into a {{i|Spooky Redcap}} instead. Planting Mushrooms in Gardening Pots lowers [[Insanity]]. A Lavender Blewit can be stored in a {{i|MushiSack}}.
